TotalChargesCleaner.source:
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.base import TransformerMixin
from factory.operators.base import Operator, OperatorMeta
from factory.schemas import OperatorKind, Modality

class TotalChargesCleaner(TransformerMixin, Operator):
    meta = OperatorMeta(
        name="TotalChargesCleaner",
        kind=OperatorKind.IMPUTER,
        version=2,
        origin="synthesized",
        description="将total_charges列中的空白字符串转换为数值，并将缺失值填充为0.0",
        conditions=["数据中存在包含空白字符的数值列"],
        dependencies=["pandas", "numpy"],
        params={"col": "total_charges"},
        parent="TotalChargesCleaner@1"
    )

    def __init__(self, col="total_charges"):
        self.col = col

    def fit(self, X, y=None):
        """记录列名以供后续调用"""
        self.col_ = self.col
        return self

    def transform(self, X):
        """
        对输入数据进行深拷贝，将目标列转为float类型，
        空白字符串及无法转换的值转为NaN，随后填充为0.0。
        """
        X = X.copy()
        if self.col_ in X.columns:
            # 依据Lesson:69d51358：先去除首尾空白，利用coerce转为数值，最后填充缺失为0
            X[self.col_] = pd.to_numeric(
                X[self.col_].astype(str).str.strip(), 
                errors="coerce"
            ).fillna(0.0)
            
            # 确保即使存在inf值也进行清理，防止后续模型报错
            X[self.col_] = X[self.col_].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], 0.0)
            
        return X

import pandas as pd
from sklearn.base import TransformerMixin
from factory.operators.base import Operator, OperatorMeta
from factory.schemas import OperatorKind

class IdColumnDropper(TransformerMixin, Operator):
    """
    删除客户ID等标识列，防止维度爆炸并避免过拟合。
    遵循 Lesson:88299a38，在特征工程初期强制剔除标识列。
    """
    meta = OperatorMeta(
        name="IdColumnDropper",
        kind=OperatorKind.FEATURE,
        version=2,
        origin="synthesized",
        description="删除客户ID等标识列，防止维度爆炸并避免过拟合",
        conditions=["id_columns"],
        dependencies=["pandas", "sklearn"],
        params={"id_cols": ("customer_id",)},
        parent="IdColumnDropper@1"
    )

    def __init__(self, id_cols=("customer_id",)):
        self.id_cols = id_cols

    def fit(self, X, y=None):
        # 记录已识别的待删除列名
        self.columns_to_drop_ = [c for c in self.id_cols if c in X.columns]
        return self

    def transform(self, X):
        X = X.copy()
        # 过滤掉不存在的列，防止推理时报错
        actual_drop = [c for c in self.columns_to_drop_ if c in X.columns]
        if actual_drop:
            X = X.drop(columns=actual_drop)
        return X

ChargeRatioFeatureGenerator.source:
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.base import TransformerMixin
from factory.operators.base import Operator, OperatorMeta
from factory.schemas import OperatorKind

class ChargeRatioFeatureGenerator(TransformerMixin, Operator):
    meta = OperatorMeta(
        name="ChargeRatioFeatureGenerator",
        kind=OperatorKind.FEATURE,
        version=2,
        origin="synthesized",
        description="基于月费与累计消费构造资费波动比值特征，处理数值转换异常与除零风险",
        conditions=["数据包含tenure, monthly_charges, total_charges列"],
        dependencies=["pandas", "numpy", "sklearn"],
        params={"monthly": "monthly_charges", "total": "total_charges", "tenure": "tenure"},
        parent="ChargeRatioFeatureGenerator@1"
    )

    def __init__(self, monthly="monthly_charges", total="total_charges", tenure="tenure"):
        self.monthly = monthly
        self.total = total
        self.tenure = tenure

    def fit(self, X, y=None):
        self.n_features_in_ = X.shape[1]
        return self

    def transform(self, X):
        X = X.copy()
        
        # 1. 确保数值列处理：先剔除空格，转数值，缺失值填充为0 (Lesson:69d51358)
        # 将 total_charges 和 monthly_charges 强制转为 float
        for col in [self.total, self.monthly, self.tenure]:
            if col in X.columns:
                if X[col].dtype == 'object':
                    X[col] = pd.to_numeric(X[col].astype(str).str.strip(), errors='coerce')
                X[col] = X[col].fillna(0)

        # 2. 计算平均费用，处理 tenure 为 0 的情况
        # avg = total / tenure。若 tenure 为 0，视为 0 消费
        tenure_safe = X[self.tenure].replace(0, np.nan)
        avg_charge = X[self.total] / tenure_safe
        
        # 3. 计算资费比值：avg / current_monthly
        # 如果当前月费为0，避免除以0产生inf
        monthly_safe = X[self.monthly].replace(0, np.nan)
        ratio = avg_charge / monthly_safe
        
        # 4. 处理无穷大及空值 (Lesson:69d51358)
        # 若计算出现inf或NaN，填充为1.0（表示当前月费与历史平均一致）
        X["charge_ratio"] = ratio.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(1.0)
        
        return X

lessons.title: 样本不平衡导致默认模型召回率偏低
lessons.trigger: 流失场景存在正负样本不平衡，模型默认阈值或未配置样本权重时召回率达不到业务要求
lessons.fix: 启用平衡类权重（如 class_weight='balanced' 或 BalancedLightGBMClassifier）以提升召回率

lessons.title: 逻辑回归标准化与可解释性
lessons.trigger: 使用逻辑回归模型，或者需要模型具有高可解释性时
lessons.fix: 必须先进行特征标准化（如 StandardFeatureScaler），在 0.1~10 之间搜索正则化强度 C，可直接输出系数给业务方。

lessons.title: 随机森林防过拟合与召回优化
lessons.trigger: 使用随机森林模型，面临过拟合风险，或业务要求召回优先时
lessons.fix: 设置 n_estimators 300 左右，限制 max_depth 在 8~16 防止过拟合；召回优先时需配合调整分类阈值。

lessons.title: 数值列含空白字符导致类型转换失败
lessons.trigger: 新入网客户累计消费为空白字符串，读取为 object 类型，转 float 时抛出 ValueError: could not convert string to float: ' '
lessons.fix: 先 str.strip()，再 pd.to_numeric(errors='coerce')，缺失值填补为 0

lessons.title: LightGBM 调参及不平衡处理
lessons.trigger: 数据量在 5k 到 10w 之间，或者样本不平衡时
lessons.fix: 设置 num_leaves 15~63, learning_rate 0.03~0.1, n_estimators 200~600；不平衡时设置 class_weight='balanced'；树模型无需标准化。
